We are seeking a professional, customer-focused, and highly motivated Customer Experience Specialist (Remote) to join our team. The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, providing exceptional support, addressing inquiries, resolving complaints, and ensuring a positive customer experience across multiple communication channels.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will be responsible for assisting customers with questions about our products and services, processing requests, troubleshooting basic issues, handling complaints, and providing accurate information in a timely and professional manner.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a strong problem-solving ability, patience, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. You should be comfortable using computers, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, email platforms, live chat applications, and other digital communication tools.

This position requires someone who is passionate about helping people, capable of managing multiple customer inquiries, and committed to maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction and service quality.
Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries through phone calls, emails, live chat, and other approved communication channels.
Provide accurate information regarding company products, services, policies, procedures, pricing, and account-related questions.
Listen carefully to customers to understand their needs, concerns, and expectations.
Maintain a friendly, patient, and professional attitude when interacting with customers.
Guide customers through processes, account updates, product usage, and general service inquiries.
Follow up with customers when necessary to ensure their concerns have been properly addressed.
Identify customer concerns and provide appropriate solutions in a timely and effective manner.
Handle customer complaints, disputes, and service-related issues with empathy and professionalism.
De-escalate difficult conversations and manage dissatisfied customers while maintaining a positive customer experience.
Investigate reported issues and coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complex problems.
Escalate unresolved or sensitive matters to the appropriate supervisor or department.
Take ownership of customer issues and ensure proper follow-through until resolution.
Assist customers with placing orders, tracking shipments, processing cancellations, and managing returns or exchanges, where applicable.
Help customers update personal information, account details, subscriptions, and service preferences.
Verify customer information and maintain accurate records of interactions and transactions.
Provide updates regarding order status, service requests, refunds, and other account-related matters.
Ensure that all customer requests are handled according to company policies and established procedures.
Record customer interactions, inquiries, complaints, and resolutions accurately in the company's CRM or customer support system.
Maintain organized and up-to-date customer records.
Document recurring issues, customer feedback, and frequently reported concerns.
Prepare reports on customer interactions, service requests, and unresolved cases when required.
Ensure that all customer information is handled confidentially and in accordance with company data protection policies.
Build positive relationships with customers through attentive, personalized, and reliable support.
Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and strengthen customer loyalty.
Educate customers about relevant products, services, features, and available solutions.
Collect customer feedback and communicate suggestions for improving products and services.
Represent the company positively in every customer interaction.
Work toward achieving customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, and service quality targets.
Collaborate with other customer service representatives, supervisors, and internal departments to resolve customer concerns.
Participate in virtual team meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Stay informed about company policies, product updates, service changes, and customer support procedures.
Follow established workflows, service standards, and communication guidelines.
Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to take on additional responsibilities when required.
q: High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
Additional education, training, or certification in customer service, business administration, communications, or a related field is an advantage.
Previous experience in customer service, call center operations, sales support, client relations, or a similar role is preferred.
Experience working with customers through phone, email, and live chat is an advantage.
Familiarity with CRM software, help desk platforms, and customer support tools is beneficial.
Candidates with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered for entry-level opportunities.
Proficiency in using computers, email applications, web browsers, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
Ability to navigate multiple software applications and digital platforms efficiently.
Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, or Freshdesk is an advantage.
Ability to type accurately and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously.
Basic troubleshooting and digital problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong active listening and comprehension abilities.
Ability to explain information clearly and communicate effectively with people from different backgrounds.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive customer relationships.
Fluency in the required working language(s).
The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate The Following Qualities
Customer-focused: Genuine interest in helping customers and ensuring their satisfaction.
Patient and empathetic: Ability to remain calm, understanding, and respectful when dealing with frustrated or demanding customers.
Problem-solver: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to identify practical solutions.
Reliable and accountable: Consistently meets deadlines, follows procedures, and takes responsibility for assigned tasks.
Detail-oriented: Ensures accuracy when documenting information, processing requests, and communicating with customers.
Organized: Able to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer inquiries efficiently.
Adaptable: Comfortable learning new technologies, processes, and company policies.
Self-motivated: Able to work independently and remain productive without constant supervision.
Team player: Willing to collaborate, share knowledge, and contribute to team objectives.
Professional: Maintains confidentiality, integrity, and a positive attitude at all times.
Since this is a fully remote position, candidates must have the ability to work effectively from home and maintain a professional working environment.
A functional laptop or desktop computer that meets company technical requirements.
A working headset with a microphone, particularly for roles involving phone support.
A quiet, distraction-free workspace suitable for professional customer interactions.
Basic knowledge of online communication and collaboration tools such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Slack.
Ability to manage working hours, meet deadlines, and maintain productivity independently.
Availability to attend virtual meetings, training sessions, and scheduled team check-ins.
Ability to comply with company security requirements and protect confidential customer information.
Performance Expectations and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Customer Service Representative will be evaluated based on measurable performance indicators, including:
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT): Maintaining high customer satisfaction through professional and effective support.
First Contact Resolution (FCR): Resolving customer concerns during the initial interaction whenever possible.
Response Time: Responding to customer inquiries within established service-level targets.
Average Handling Time (AHT): Managing customer interactions efficiently without compromising service quality.
Quality Assurance Score: Maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and compliance with company communication standards.

d: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Inventory Controller to manage the spare parts inventory for our heavy equipment portfolio, specializing in forklifts, cranes, bearings, and commercial trucks. This role is critical to ensuring optimal stock levels, minimizing downtime for our customers, and maximizing inventory efficiency across our multi-segment business.
q: High school diploma or equivalent with 3+ years in parts inventory control · Preferred: associate or bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, or related field
r: Maintain accurate inventory records for all spare parts across four key segments: forklifts, industrial cranes, bearings/bushings, and commercial truck components
Implement and manage minimum/maximum (min/max) stock levels and reorder points based on historical data, seasonality, and demand forecasts
Conduct regular cycle counts and lead annual physical inventory audits with precision
Manage slow-moving and obsolete (SLOBS) inventory through strategic disposition plans Coordinate with purchasing team on parts procurement, backorders, and supplier performance
Utilize technical manuals, parts catalogs, and cross-reference tools to accurately identify parts for complex mechanical systems
Provide technical support to the sales and service teams regarding part specifications, interchangeability, and compatibility
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of OEM parts numbering systems and aftermarket alternatives Manage serial number-specific parts and custom configurations for specialized equipment
Analyze consumption patterns, failure rates, and seasonal demand variations across all equipment categories
Develop segment-specific forecasting models to predict parts demand
Monitor equipment population in service territory to anticipate future parts requirements
Generate and analyze inventory performance reports (turnover rates, fill rates, obsolescence)
Manage relationships with key suppliers and OEMs for each product segment
Coordinate with the logistics team to optimize inbound and outbound parts flow
Implement and maintain efficient warehouse layout and storage systems
Ensure proper handling and storage of sensitive components (seals, electronics, hydraulic parts)
Master inventory management software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Epicor, DMS)
Maintain accurate pricing, costing, and bin location data in all systems
Develop and document inventory control procedures specific to different product categories
Implement barcode/RFID systems for efficient parts tracking and retrieval
